general_rules.rule: Customs fills: 7 (registration number), 44 (its own documents e.g. inspection act), 47 (fees for out-of-hours/out-of-place clearance), «А» (paper additional sheets only), «В» (e-GTD only: totals per payment code; exemptions marked 'без оплаты'), «D» (decision marks).
Declaration is electronic via the e-declaration system, signed with the declaring person's ЭЦП; all data go into the e-GTD fields/detail tables – no references to other grafas or attachments.

One GTD may cover goods sent from one consignor to one consignee under one transport document and one regime (road: several transport documents allowed only under the extra conditions of point 4). Different regimes → separate GTDs.
One item = goods of one name, type and brand, one 10-digit code, one origin (or one economic union / unknown), same tariff and non-tariff treatment.

Consumer goods (except TN VED 4901, 4902, 4908–4911) not for own needs, same code but different names, trademarks, brands, models or specs → declared as separate items. Pharma (group 30) and 9018: extra mandatory attributes.
Fill in Uzbek or Russian; no erasures; names written in Latin/other scripts in source docs go in Latin letters, Cyrillic names stay Cyrillic.
No information not provided for by the Instruction may be entered.
Not using available payment benefits/preferences and not reflecting them in the GTD is also treated as a deficiency at pre-check.

Declarant keeps the GTD and supporting documents for the period of Customs Code Art. 184 part 3: three years from the year following the year in which goods lost the status of goods under customs control.

grafas.format: free text, separate e-GTD fields per party
grafas.rule_en: Person named as consignor in the transport document: for a legal entity – short name + location (country short name per Annex 5 + address); for an individual – full name + residence. If the consignor ships on behalf of another person: consignor first, then 'по поручению' + the person who contracted with the grafa-9 party. In the e-GTD each party goes into its own field. Optional consignor TIN after '№' only for simplified corridor / AEO mutual-recognition cases. Latin-script names stay in Latin (point 11).
grafas.example: Foshan Mingde Furniture Co., Ltd. (SYNTHETIC), Китай, Guangdong, Foshan, Shunde, Longjiang Rd 88
cross_checks: CMR box 1 consignor = invoice seller (or 'on behalf of' chain explained)
grafas.notes: Not filled on additional sheets of a paper GTD.

grafas.format: free text + upper-right code after № + bottom: № TIN / district code
grafas.rule_en: Importer/consignee: legal entity – short name, legal address, phone, e-mail (if any); individual – full name, permanent address, phone. If consignee ≠ importer: consignee first, then 'по поручению' importer. If grafa 9 already shows the importer, the importer need not be repeated here. Upper-right after '№': 00000001 resident individual, 00000002 non-resident individual, 00000003 organisation with state share, 99999999 diplomatic missions, 88888888 international/governmental organisation offices; otherwise empty. Bottom after '№': consignee TIN (of the branch if a branch acts), '/', district (city) code per Annex 15; no TIN → 999999999.
grafas.example: «UYJIHOZ SAVDO» MChJ (SYNTHETIC), г. Ташкент, Чиланзарский р-н, ул. Бунёдкор 1, тел. +998 71 000 00 00 | № 123456789/1726294

grafas.notes: Not filled on additional sheets of a paper GTD.

grafas.name_uz_cyrl: Юк жойлари ва товар тавсифи / Маркировка ва миқдор — контейнерлар рақами — товар тавсифи

grafas.name_ru: Грузовые места и описание товара / Маркировка и количество — номера контейнеров — описание товара
grafas.format: numbered lines 1–11 + bottom-left consumer TIN/district + bottom-right supplementary quantity
grafas.rule_en: Description sufficient for unambiguous 10-digit classification. Line 1: trade name, trademark/brand, model, article, grade, standards, technical and commercial characteristics, quantitative and qualitative composition; energy-efficiency class for appliances listed in the annex to CM Resolution No. 86 of 09.04.2015; e-GTD: brand in separate field ('без марки'/'без бренда' if none); parameters in other units and production date when needed for payments or measures. Using only the TN VED heading text is NOT allowed. Line 2: number of packages, packaging type and number of packings ('часть коробки' if partial; bulk codes 01 насыпью/02 навалом/03 наливом). Line 3: container numbers ('часть' if partial). Line 4: excise stamps. Line 5: pipeline/power-line supply period. Line 6: aggregated import code (separate table). Line 7: shelf life for food and medicines. Line 8: investment-project codes (101/102/103/201/202/203 and further codes in the text). Line 9: 3-digit technological-equipment sphere code (Annex 16) for listed HS headings, '000' if sphere not listed. Line 10: year of manufacture / technical parameters of such equipment. Line 11: '01' state procurement / '02' not state procurement. Bottom-left: TIN/PINFL of the end consumer + '/' district code (unknown or several → consignee). Bottom-right: quantity in supplementary unit, 2 decimals (6 if < 0.01); e-GTD: number only; not filled if only 'kg'.
grafas.example:
1) Стол обеденный из массива гевеи, модель DT-1600, 1600x900x750 мм, бренд MINGDE ...
2) 80 мест, картонные коробки
... | 123456789/1726294 | 40,00
cross_checks: packages (line 2) = CMR box 6-7 = packing list = invoice
supp. quantity = invoice qty = packing list qty
description not equal to bare heading text
grafas.notes: One item = same name, type, brand, one 10-digit code, one origin, same tariff treatment (point 7). Consumer goods with the same code but different names/brands/models/specs must be separate items (point 8). For smartphones: IMEI required in grafa 31 per tariff team note (VM 778) – out of demo scope.

grafas.rule_en: Previous document. Previous GTD: 'ГТД post/date/number — item — gross — net — supp qty'. Customs transit: 'ТД 06010/01.03.2022/0003761 — 3 — 7980 кг — 7900 кг — 350,2 м3'. No GTD/TD but delivery-control document: 'ККДГ post/date/ИМnumber — gross' (Cyrillic letters) or 'МДП post/date/XYnumber — gross' (Latin letters). Several previous documents → one per line. Vehicle imported under return obligation → 'МB …'.
grafas.notes: For a truck cleared at an inland post the transit declaration is normally the previous document (Customs Code Art. 261 part 3).

grafas.rule_en: Documents supporting each item, each with ordinal code and letter code per Annex 12: licence (101 ЛИЦЕНЗИЯ … срок), transport & commercial docs (202 СМР, 220 ИНВ, 221 ИНВПРФ, 222 УПЛИСТ, 223 ИНВ_ОТ …), contract (301 КНТ), supplementary agreement (302 ДОП), contract specification (307 SPES_N), transport contract with non-resident carrier (305 КНТ_ТР) and its e-system ID (306 IDN_ТР), permits & certificates (e.g. 417 ССТ conformity certificate, 441 MTD declaration of conformity), contract registration (501…), benefits ('6' + payment code + Annex 14 act code, e.g. '629 15-142120030000'), certificate of origin (701 СПТИМ), other docs (deferral, commission contract, fine decision, foreign export declaration …). Customs adds its own entries (inspection act etc., point 90).

additional_document_codes.purpose: States which customs valuation method was used for the item's customs value (grafa 45). Customs Code Art. 302 lists the methods for imported goods: transaction value (Art. 303), identical goods (Art. 309), similar goods (Art. 310), deduction (Art. 311), addition/computed (Art. 312), fall-back (Art. 313).
additional_document_codes.proposed_line_format: 904 МЕТОД <method number> — e.g. '904 МЕТОД 1' for transaction value (Art. 303)
additional_document_codes.status: OUR READING of Instruction 2773 ch.5 p.25 sub-point 39 'з) иные документы и сведения' + Annex 12 item 113 (code 904 МЕТОД). UNVERIFIED on live ed2: the Instruction does not say WHEN 904 is mandatory or HOW the method is written (number vs text); the format above is a proposal.
additional_document_codes.demo_note: Demo answer keys do not include a 904 line; add '904 МЕТОД 1' if ed2 confirms it is required for transaction-value declarations.

grafas.rule_en: Right subfield: customs value of the item in contract currency (gratuitous/no contract → currency of accompanying documents), determined by the Customs Code valuation methods (Arts. 302–313). Round to 2 decimals.
cross_checks: ≥ invoice value when Incoterms leave freight to the border unpaid (Art. 304)
grafas.notes: Left subfield content is not described for IM40 in point 25 ⚠️ (cabinet may require valuation-method code).

grafas.format: table rows: Вид | Основа начисления | Ставка | Сумма | СП
grafas.rule_en: Per item and per payment type. 'Вид' = payment code (Annex 13: 10 clearance fee, 20 import duty, 21 additional duty, 27 import excise, 29 VAT …). 'Основа' in UZS (conversion of grafa 12/45 at CBU rate on acceptance date) unless law sets a foreign-currency or non-money base (then quantity + unit). 'Ставка' = applied rate. 'Сумма' in UZS. 'СП' method: БН bank transfer, КТ cash, УН conditional accrual, ОП deferral, РП instalments, ПП per-batch under periodic GTD, ВЗ VAT offset, ОО not payable. Clearance fees always shown only once (e-GTD: under item No. 1). No row when rate not set / zero or no obligation under the regime.
grafas.notes: Customs adds fees for clearance outside working hours/places (point 90). Rounding of UZS amounts is not stated in the instruction ⚠️.

legal_source.doc: Instruction on the procedure for filling in the cargo customs declaration (BYD/GTD), MoJ reg. No. 2773 of 06.04.2016

grafas.format: fixed sentence + full name, position, phone, PINFL (+ power of attorney)
grafas.rule_en: Text: 'Ответственность за представленные документы и сведения несет …' + full name, position, phone, PINFL (separate e-GTD field) of the person responsible – the declarant or its authorised person. Non-resident without PINFL → 14 nines. If an authorised person: number, date and validity of the contract/power of attorney.
grafas.example: Ответственность ... несет Каримов Азиз Бахромович, директор, +998 90 000 00 00 | ПИНФЛ 12345678901234 (SYNTHETIC)

legal_source.doc: Instruction on the procedure for filling in the cargo customs declaration (BYD/GTD), MoJ reg. No. 2773 of 06.04.2016

grafas.format: numbered lines 1–5; GTD own number PINFL/DD.MM.YYYY/serial
grafas.rule_en: Declaring person filing on behalf of the grafa-14 person: 1 place of filling; 2 full name + e-mail; 3 phone; 4 (broker only) number/date of broker–client contract; 5 declarant's own GTD number '99999999999999/99.99.9999/999999' = PINFL / filling date / serial number increasing within the year (restarts each year, never repeated). E-GTD authenticity is certified by the declaring person's ЭЦП (ERI).
grafas.example:
1) г. Ташкент
2) Каримов Азиз Бахромович, info@example.uz
3) +998 90 000 00 00
5) 12345678901234/26.11.2026/000017
grafas.notes: 'Declaring person' = declarant filing itself or a customs-clearance specialist employed by the declarant/broker (point 1).

legal_source.doc: Instruction on the procedure for filling in the cargo customs declaration (BYD/GTD), MoJ reg. No. 2773 of 06.04.2016

cross_checks: contract registered in the e-system (ID present)

paper additional sheets only: registration number from grafa 7
e-GTD only: per payment code, total amount over all items; exemptions shown with 'без оплаты'
